name: example-tool
_comment: REFERENCE CELL — dummy data only. This documents the cell schema that `hv wire` consumes. Real per-node cells are gitignored (see .gitignore) so private infra details never land in the public repo: copy this file, fill in your tool, and journal it with `hv wire --add <file>`. Never put a real account id, site id, or secret in a tracked cell.

spec.obtain: Where/how to get the credential, e.g. 'dashboard -> Settings -> API -> Create token'. Leave generic (or drop `requires`) when the tool needs no credential.

steps: # shell steps to wire this tool on Linux (e.g. register an MCP server)

gotchas: One gotcha per line — rate limits, auth-header quirks, common error codes.
Keep every line GENERIC: never embed a real account id, site id, hostname, or secret.
